title: A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Four customers have open invoices on today's date: {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C} and {Customer-D}. Their names start with the same word and then differ by a number, a dash or capitals, as in the example.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-01 10 Trucking, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-01 2 Trucking, {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-01 A-1 Towing, {Customer-D} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-01 a1 towing.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without clicking any column header, find the four customers in the list (use the page controls if they are on a later page).
  2. Read the order of the four customers from top to bottom.
  3. Look at the header of the customer name column (the first column).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: all four customers are listed.
  • Step 2: they read {Customer-A}, then {Customer-B}, then {Customer-C}, then {Customer-D} (other customers may sit between them). With the example names: "10 Trucking" comes before "2 Trucking" because names compare character by character, and "A-1 Towing" comes before "a1 towing" because capitals are ignored and the dash compares as a character.
  • Step 3: the customer name column (the first column) is marked as the sorted column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
  • S1-R2: “Name order compares names ignoring capitals, in plain character order: digits and punctuation compare as characters, so "10 Trucking" comes before "2 Trucking" and "A-1 Towing" before "a1 towing".”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
